beyonder_pathways.description: The mystical systems of progression for Beyonders, each divided into sequences.

list.name: Seer Pathway
list.description: A pathway focused on divination, control, and ritual magic. It is the protagonist's pathway in the first book.

list.name: Apprentice Pathway
list.description: A pathway centered around mobility, evasion, and spatial shenanigans.

list.name: Spectator Pathway
list.description: A pathway for mind-readers and manipulators, focused on observation and mental influence.

list.name: Warrior Pathway
list.description: A pathway focused on melee combat, mastery of weapons, and physical prowess.

list.name: Bard Pathway
list.description: A pathway with holy songs, party support, and tanking capabilities, represented by the Sun.

list.name: Hermit Pathway
list.description: A pathway focused on occult knowledge, mysticism, and prying secrets. It is oriented around knowledge and spellcasting.

list.name: Hunter Pathway
list.description: A pathway based on combat, tracking, and manipulation, specializing in provoking enemies. Its abilities include fire manipulation and conspiracy weaving at higher sequences.

list.name: Paragon Pathway
list.description: A pathway that combines science and craftsmanship. Higher sequences can create artificial life and perform transmutation.

list.name: Darkness Pathway
list.description: A pathway associated with the night, concealment, and slumber. It is controlled by the Church of the Evernight Goddess.
